art_direction: 层叠叶片与一枚小月在深蓝底上构成紧凑夜园，边缘干净、颜色克制。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Compose a compact imaginary night garden from flat cutout shapes: broad leaves, two curled stems, a small circular moon, and one closed bud. Use deep navy, muted turquoise, mustard, and warm ivory, keeping each color in large readable areas. Interlock the leaves around an open central channel so the composition has air rather than becoming a dense pattern. Add a few smaller leaf notches and paired stem curves for close viewing. Use crisp flat edges without paper shadows, gradients, or naturalistic plant rendering. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
